name: latex-to-word
description: Convert an Elsevier elsarticle or ACS achemso LaTeX manuscript or Supporting Information into a submission-ready Word .docx: numbered equations, SVG figures (multi-panel figures as typeset), booktabs tables, live EndNote citations from a per-paper library (or static citations), DOI checks, journal-ready figure PDFs, a marked copy against an earlier version, and sentence-level verification against the compiled PDF.
